title: Rules

docker-doctor ships 31 rules across 5 categories. Every diagnostic carries a full rule key (e.g. `docker-doctor/no-root-user`) that you can pass to `rules explain` or use to tune severity in your config. Each rule below links to a page with failing and fixed examples.

List everything docker-doctor knows about:

```bash
npx @docker-doctor/cli@latest rules list
```

Explain any single rule in depth:

```bash
npx @docker-doctor/cli@latest rules explain <rule>
```

## Security

Catches Dockerfile patterns that widen your attack surface.

| Rule | What it checks | Severity |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`no-root-user`](/docs/reference/rules/no-root-user) | Run the container as a non-root user | <SeverityPill severity="warning" /> |
| [`no-secrets-in-env`](/docs/reference/rules/no-secrets-in-env) | Avoid storing secrets in ENV or ARG instructions | <SeverityPill severity="error" /> |
| [`pin-image-version`](/docs/reference/rules/pin-image-version) | Pin base images to a specific tag or digest | <SeverityPill severity="warning" /> |
| [`no-add-remote`](/docs/reference/rules/no-add-remote) | Avoid using ADD with remote URLs | <SeverityPill severity="warning" /> |

## Performance

Reduces build time and layer bloat.

| Rule | What it checks | Severity |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`use-multi-stage`](/docs/reference/rules/use-multi-stage) | Use multi-stage builds | <SeverityPill severity="info" /> |
| [`order-layers`](/docs/reference/rules/order-layers) | Order layers to maximize build cache utility | <SeverityPill severity="warning" /> |

| [`use-dockerignore`](/docs/reference/rules/use-dockerignore) | Add a .dockerignore file | <SeverityPill severity="warning" /> |

| [`require-healthcheck`](/docs/reference/rules/require-healthcheck) | Add a HEALTHCHECK instruction | <SeverityPill severity="info" /> |
